results.timing_boundary: inference entry through checked output opening and final CUDA synchronization; setup excluded
results.methodology: Experimental Rep4 variant; ChaCha20 masks and BLAKE3 integrity checks execute during every online/replay run. Not byte compatible with MP-SPDZ/reference masks or tags. Device replay assumes peer payloads already delivered to GPU; host replay includes outgoing/incoming host staging. Both exclude network latency/bandwidth. Fresh unrecorded live timings and a separate untimed transcript; outgoing bytes checked during replay warmup. Domain keys, input sharing and static weight preparation are setup. Floor outputs match the exact integer fixture; probabilistic outputs agree across parties and obey propagated rounding intervals. Every replay exactly matches the recorded output. Reported errors are worst-case over fresh warmup, live and recorded runs.
